declarations.description: Light-DOM enhancement of one direct details child. Native summary interaction works without JavaScript. No shadow root, slots, CSS parts, dependencies, or network requests. Initial upgrade adopts details.open unless the host open attribute is present; no initial change event. Missing details is inert; direct child insertion is observed. Reconnection adopts current markup without emitting an initial event.

declarations.description: Owns native buttons with data-action=start|pause|restart|left|right|up|down|fire. Arrow keys/WASD move, Space fires, P/Escape pause. Held pointers support multi-touch. declarations.description: Repeating bitmap sampled into a canvas on demand. The first direct img supplies the texture and accessible alternative. A direct game-screen layer containing a game-tilemap scrolls the map with CSS. Extend the layer beyond the screen when scrolling should reveal more tiles. In a game-world, the perspective mode projects a CSS ground plane and scenery layers use factor and drift for parallax.
